name: Minor Miracle (Mythic)
body:
The miracles your deity grants to you are as great as your faith.

Prerequisite(s): Minor Miracle.

Benefit(s): Add 1/2 your mythic tier to the number of times per day you can use the Mythic Miracle feat. You may use the feat to cast any one spell from the selected domains whose level is equal or lesser than your mythic tier.

Legendary Classes: Defenders of the Faith © 2024, Legendary Games; Jason Nelson, Aaron Hollingsworth, Amber Scott, Andrew J. Gibson, Carl Cramer, Clinton J. Boomer, Connor Bates, Jenny Jarzabski, Margherita Tramontano, Matt Daley, Nathan Reinecke, and Norman Mitchell Jr.
